company.name: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence

profile_text.body:
The German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI) is a non-profit government laboratory headquartered in Kaiserslautern, Germany. Its website describes the center as recognized by the international scientific community as a major "Center of Excellence" in AI, with a focus on human-centric AI for more than 30 years. It states that DFKI combines scientific excellence and commercially-oriented value creation with social awareness.

The center's site reports a new partnership between Canadian and German AI research institutions to advance trustworthy AI, and a magazine issue on perception, understanding, and agency of AI systems. It also notes a June 18, 2026 announcement involving DFKI and the French National Institute for Research in Digital...

No products, litigation, MCP servers, or SEC and patent records are associated with DFKI.
